title: Security: RBAC, Pod Hardening & Policies
summary: Control who can do what (authn, RBAC, ServiceAccounts), what pods are allowed to do (securityContext, Pod Security Admission), who can talk to whom (NetworkPolicies) and what may enter the cluster at all (admission policies, image security).
objectives: Explain the API request path: authentication, authorization, admission
Grant least-privilege access with Role/ClusterRole and bindings, and verify it with kubectl auth can-i
Use ServiceAccounts and bound, projected tokens correctly, and disable token mounting when not needed
Harden pods with securityContext and enforce Pod Security Standards with namespace labels
Write default-deny NetworkPolicies and allow traffic by pod and namespace labels
Enforce custom rules with ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL) and know when to reach for Kyverno or Gatekeeper
Describe image supply-chain controls and how pods get AWS credentials on EKS (IRSA, Pod Identity)
